title: Real sparse Fourier expansion
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\mathcal F$ be a finite family of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and assign a rational coefficient to each member of $\mathcal F$. Extend these coefficients to all subsets by using zero outside $\mathcal F$, and regard them as real numbers. The hypothesis formed from $\mathcal F$ and the rational coefficients has real value, at every sign vector, equal to the sum over $\mathcal F$ of the extended real coefficient times the corresponding sign monomial.
